channel.title: LC Insight
channel.description: Read the chain, not the rumors. Crypto market news and on-chain analysis.

item.title: K3's sBOLD vault hit with 10,000 borrowed wstETH and 9 million new BOLD in one transaction
item.description: An attacker hit K3 Capital's sBOLD savings vault on Ethereum on Wednesday morning. In one public transaction it borrowed 10,000 wstETH from Morpho, minted 9 million BOLD, cycled it through the vault and then paid ether to the wallet that built the attack contract.

item.title: Bitcoin fell to $62,068, and 97 top Hyperliquid traders are 93% short with $694 million
item.description: DeepSea counts $693.71 million of bitcoin shorts against $55.60 million of longs among 97 top Hyperliquid traders. With an average short entry of $72,018, the group is well in profit as bitcoin trades near $63,400.

item.title: Irys jumped 58% in a day as trading volume rose more than 40 times, led by Korean won pairs
item.description: IRYS climbed to about $0.025 while bitcoin fell. Daily volume went from about $3.4 million to $161 million, and Upbit's won market carried the most trading, CoinGecko data show.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs lost $157.5 million Wednesday, pushing November's outflow to $2.55 billion
item.description: U.S. spot bitcoin funds had a second straight outflow day as bitcoin closed near $62,500. Ether funds lost $17 million, their third outflow day in a row.

item.title: USDT on Plasma jumped 58% in 17 days to $1.09 billion while total USDT shrank
item.description: DefiLlama data show USDT on the Plasma chain rose $401 million since November 2, even as total USDT fell $598 million in a week. It is still about 80% below its October 18, 2025, peak of $5.35 billion.

item.title: USDC on Circle's Arc chain grew $245 million in a week as total USDC shrank $1.1 billion
item.description: DefiLlama data put USDC on Arc at $1.60 billion, up 18% in a week and 3.5 times its September low. It is level with Polygon, a hair behind in seventh place among USDC chains.

item.title: DeepSea's top two traders made $78.7 million in a week but hold just $14.5 million
item.description: SMc060 is back at No. 1 on DeepSea's smart money board, with SM6e36 right behind. SM6e36's assets roughly halved in a day while its profit rose, and Arbiscan shows neither wallet keeps any Aave USDC on Arbitrum.

item.title: One shark pulled $10.2 million of USDC from Aave on Arbitrum in a single trade
item.description: An unlabeled wallet made the day's biggest shark sale on any chain, more than 10 times the next one. Arbiscan shows it now holds none of the Aave token, and the pool's supply fell 7% in a day.

item.title: Pieverse jumps 66% in a day to a record $3.64 as Upbit retakes the lead in trading
item.description: PIEVERSE kept climbing after Wednesday morning's high and set another record in the evening while bitcoin and ether fell. Volume nearly quadrupled, and South Korea's Upbit carried 44% of it.

item.title: Gonka's Ethereum bridge lost $884,000 in USDT in one minute, then 22 million WGNK were minted
item.description: A wallet funded six hours earlier set a new key on Gonka's Ethereum bridge, pulled out 884,150 USDT and minted 22 million wrapped GNK on November 18, 2026. The WGNK price fell about 84% by evening.

item.title: Extended's XTEN airdrop: 300 million tokens, about 4.29 per point, sign by December 31
item.description: Perpetuals exchange Extended has set aside 30% of its XTEN token for points holders and opened a signing step in its app. U.S., UK and Canadian users are excluded, and half the supply goes to founders, team and investors.

item.title: Rumor vs record: Solana 1.0 is real; Zelle's $1.25 million stage transfer is unconfirmed
item.description: Solana's London conference set off a wave of posts: Solana 1.0, 150-millisecond finality, Zelle picking Solana, a $1.25 million on-stage transfer and NYSE's owner getting ready for Solana tokens. We checked six claims against official pages and CoinGecko. Three hold up, one is misleading and two cannot be confirmed.

item.title: Pieverse hits record $2.52, up 132% in 30 days, as PancakeSwap pool takes 37.4% of trading
item.description: PIEVERSE beat its November 9 high on Wednesday morning while bitcoin slipped. This time a PancakeSwap pool on BNB Chain, not South Korea's Upbit, handled the largest share of the volume.

item.title: Momentum (MMT) doubles to $0.25 in a day as trading volume hits 100 times last week's
item.description: The token of a Sui-based exchange ran from about $0.12 to $0.25 in 24 hours, with $310 million traded against a $51 million market value. It is still 94% below its 2025 record.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs' Tuesday outflow revised to $241.9 million; ether funds lost $26.3 million
item.description: Revised CoinMarketCap data show U.S. spot bitcoin funds lost $241.9 million on Tuesday, November 17, not $32.4 million. Ether funds lost $26.3 million instead of taking in $1.3 million.

item.title: Fake 'USDC' copied an $8.46 million Aave withdrawal to the cent, minutes after it happened
item.description: Two big wallets left Aave on Arbitrum on Tuesday. Within minutes, lookalike tokens started writing the same amounts into their histories, and Arbiscan tags the sender as phishing.

item.title: Smart money trader SMad53 traded $47.6 billion in 30 days. Its open bets total $3.06 million
item.description: The No. 6 wallet on DeepSea's 7-day board made $28.57 million in a month after a flat 90 days. It holds 30 small bets, all at 3x, and one bitcoin short makes up 90% of the total.

item.title: Two sharks pulled $18.5 million of USDC from Aave on Arbitrum in a day. Both now hold none
item.description: The No. 2 trader on DeepSea's smart money board took out its last $10.05 million. An unlabeled wallet withdrew $8.46 million. Arbiscan shows both balances at zero.

item.title: KOL 'tech' bought five PIKA tokens within a second of launch. Each pool now holds under $1
item.description: DeepSea logs the BNB Chain wallet buying every new PIKA within one second of launch. DexScreener now shows all five pools with less than $1 of liquidity.

item.title: SparkLend shrank $447 million in seven days while Maple grew 5.7% in a single day
item.description: DefiLlama data show the lender SparkLend fell 10% since November 10 to $4.00 billion, with a $404 million drop in one day. Lender Maple rose to $2.33 billion.

item.title: Rumor vs record: no official date for Predict.fun's airdrop claim, and no MetaMask token
item.description: Posts say PREDICT's delayed Season 1 claim opens November 18 and that a MetaMask token claim closes November 26. We checked four claims against official pages and CoinGecko. Three could not be confirmed on any official page we could open, and one is wrong.

item.title: $515 million left Hyperliquid's bridge in 8 days. Arbitrum's USDC rose $92 million in a day
item.description: DefiLlama data show the Hyperliquid Bridge fell 8.4% since November 9 and USDC on Hyperliquid's chain dropped $194 million in a day. USDC on Arbitrum, Base Bridge and LayerZero gained.

item.title: Pearl climbed 53% in six days to $1.84 as bitcoin fell. Only 18% of its coins are out
item.description: The coin of Pearl, a blockchain that pays GPU miners for AI math, is back on CoinGecko's trending list. Its market value rose by about $184 million in a week, but all 2.1 billion coins would be worth $3.86 billion.

item.title: Sky's USDS lost $1.63 billion in a month, almost a quarter of its supply
item.description: The 12 biggest dollar stablecoins shrank $850 million in a day and $3.61 billion in a week, DefiLlama data show. USDS fell $121 million in a day, and USDC lost ground on Hyperliquid, Solana and Base.

item.title: Binance opens a $500 million Anthropic IPO token sale, a day after cutting its perp price 13x
item.description: Binance Wallet takes USDC orders for Anthropic stock tokens from 1 a.m. to 9 a.m. ET on Wednesday, at an indicative $70 to $78 each. On Tuesday, Binance Futures shrank the price of its Anthropic pre-IPO contract by a factor of 13.116 and renamed it ANTUSDT.

item.title: infiniFi airdropped 8.3% of INFI on Tuesday. The token is 88% below its first trade
item.description: The yield protocol sent INFI straight into eligible wallets on Ethereum and Base on November 17, 2026. Trading opened near $0.92 and slid to about $0.10 by midnight ET, which puts all 100 million tokens at roughly $10.6 million.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs took in $9.6 million Monday, ending a 7-day outflow run, then lost $32.4 million
item.description: CoinMarketCap's revised data show U.S. spot bitcoin funds took in $9.6 million on Monday, November 16, their first inflow since November 4. On Tuesday they lost $32.4 million as bitcoin dipped below $64,000.

item.title: Bitway (BTW) bounces 32% in a day, but it is still 84% below its October record
item.description: BTW climbed from a low near $0.335 late Monday to about $0.45 on Tuesday evening, after falling more than 60% in a week. A PancakeSwap pool on BNB Chain carried half the trading.

item.title: Rain (RAIN) has given back 40% since Monday's peak, and HTX carried half the trading
item.description: RAIN topped out near $0.0079 early Monday, November 16, then slid to about $0.0048 by Tuesday evening. Only about $20 million traded against a market value of $3.4 billion.

item.title: Brevis (BREV) doubled in a day from a record low, and 37% of the trading ran through Upbit
item.description: BREV hit an all-time low near $0.0554 on Monday night, then ran to about $0.132 by Tuesday morning. It is still about 80% below its January record.

item.title: Rumor vs record: Hyperliquid Strategies applied for a U.S. futures license. It has not got one
item.description: Posts say the Nasdaq-listed HYPE holder got a U.S. futures license after a $620.6 million quarter. We checked each line against its own SEC filing. It applied. It has not been approved.

item.title: SM7d72 holds $88 million in Ether and bitcoin shorts, $19.2 million up on paper
item.description: The No. 3 trader on DeepSea's 7-day board has a $47.6 million Ether short at 25x and a $40.4 million bitcoin short at 40x, plus $55 million in USDC.

item.title: Sharks sold $37.6 million in 24 hours: one wallet dumped $9.5 million of Aave USDC
item.description: DeepSea's 24-hour shark feed shows sells outweighing buys by 3 to 1. The biggest sells are dollar tokens, plus $4.6 million of a Circle-linked token.

item.title: Smart money wallet SMd4f8 is $3.66 million down on a $6.91 million HYPE short
item.description: The No. 12 trader on DeepSea's 7-day board shorted Hyperliquid's HYPE token near $32.46. HYPE now trades near $69, so the bet is deep under water.

item.title: Injective jumps 12% to $7.48 with no confirmed cause. INJ is still 86% below its record
item.description: INJ was one of CoinGecko's trending coins on November 17 with a 12% daily gain. We checked the numbers and found no official announcement that explains it.

item.title: More bitcoin went onto exchanges than left: net 1,387 BTC in a day, and Binance took 2,479
item.description: DeepSea's exchange flow panel shows 20,536 BTC in and 19,148 BTC out. Kraken, Bitfinex and OKX lost coins while Binance and Bybit gained.

item.title: Marc Zeller's Hyperliquid wallet made $126,600 in a week, two thirds of its 30-day profit
item.description: DeepSea ranks the wallet No. 6 on its KOL board. It moved $1.70 million of volume, holds little else, and shows no flags in DeepSea's risk database.

item.title: A shark with 81,000+ trades a month just bought $6 million of RLUSD, 99% of its basket
item.description: DeepSea's shark Hold91cc swapped into 18 tokens within one minute on Ethereum. Only one was big: Ripple's dollar stablecoin.

item.title: Smart money wallet SM54b0 is all short: $36.5 million in bets, $12.1 million up on paper
item.description: The No. 9 trader on DeepSea's 7-day board has ten open Hyperliquid shorts and no long positions. Together they show about $12.1 million of paper profit.

item.title: Solana ETFs took in $11.7 million on Monday, the most since September, as SOL fell 11%
item.description: U.S. spot Solana funds broke a month of selling on November 16, CoinMarketCap data show. XRP funds saw no net flow, and XRP slipped below $1.

item.title: One shark sold $4.64 million of a Circle stock token worth $8 million in all
item.description: One trade by a wallet down $2.93 million in a week was worth more than half of rCRCL's total market value. Another losing shark sold $1.66 million of a SpaceX stock token.

item.title: Two top-10 traders are short $117.7 million of bitcoin and ether, up $26.6 million on paper
item.description: SMdfdb and SM7da2 sit No. 6 and No. 8 on DeepSea's 7-day board. One holds a $55 million ether short from $2,283, the other a $56.3 million bitcoin short from $78,440.

item.title: HYPE jumped 6% with top traders 91% short. The biggest short is $17.9 million in the red
item.description: DeepSea counts $286.5 million of HYPE shorts against $26.8 million of longs among 63 top Hyperliquid traders. The biggest bet against HYPE, opened near $28.79, shows a $17.9 million paper loss.

item.title: The top two traders' accounts shrank $206 million in two days, and $29.5 million left Aave
item.description: SMc060 and SM6e36 still lead DeepSea's 7-day profit board, but the assets DeepSea lists for them fell from $230.8 million to $24.6 million. On Arbitrum, their wallets pulled $29.5 million of USDC out of Aave in a day.

item.title: Backpack's BP jumped 48% in two hours, then gave back a fifth. Most volume hit Solana pools
item.description: BP went from about $0.84 at 4 p.m. ET to about $1.25 at 6 p.m. ET on Monday, CoinGecko data show, and sat near $1.00 after midnight. Daily volume rose about elevenfold.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs bled $1.72 billion over seven straight outflow days as bitcoin slid to $65,000
item.description: U.S. spot bitcoin funds had a net outflow of $185.4 million on Friday, CoinMarketCap data show, and Monday's figure was revised to a $9.6 million inflow. The seven-day run is their longest in the 63 sessions CoinMarketCap's 90-day chart covers.

item.title: Lighter's LIT rose 28% from Monday's low, above its price before the $10.4 million loss
item.description: LIT traded at $3.00 early Tuesday, CoinGecko data show, about 9% above where it stood before Lighter froze withdrawals. Daily volume is about four times its pre-incident level.

item.title: PayPal's PYUSD shrank $269 million in a day and is down 22% from its October 27 peak
item.description: PYUSD's market value fell 10.2% in 24 hours to $2.38 billion, CoinGecko data show, the biggest one-day drop of any top-30 stablecoin. The price held at $1.

item.title: Bless (BLESS) more than doubled in a day, and it is still 91% below its 2025 record
item.description: BLESS climbed from about $0.0090 to a peak near $0.0194 in 15 hours on Monday, with a single PancakeSwap pool carrying about 41% of the trading.

item.title: One leaked API key cost a Lighter trader about $10.4 million. Lighter froze all withdrawals
item.description: Lighter says a single trader's leaked API key, not a bug in its contracts, let an attacker pull about $10.4 million in USDC on November 16, 2026. On-chain trackers show the money swapped to ether and sent to Hyperliquid.
